Board 01 — the coverage views R6 #1292 #1290 · ADR-0053 (2026-11-02) · A4 #957

Two-way coverage, due by the end of Sprint 23. R6 (Sprint 22) shipped two agent-only reads, GET /api/v1/splits/incomplete and GET /api/v1/transactions/rate_only; the ADR-0053 amendment of 2026-11-02 adds a third, GET /api/v1/transactions/cash_mismatch. A4 (#957) shipped flow_changes in the depot and security merge previews' API. None of them has a human view.

Q1 — where the three checks are read: A, three more findings on the Overview's data-quality line, each opening the history filtered to its rows under its remedy. B (a section on the Imports page) is drawn for contrast. A comment „Q1 B“ flips it. Q2 — severity: problem; each can make a figure wrong. „Q2 attention“ flips it. ①b is a conformance repair (before/after); Q3 — the absorbed phrase stays in „Ändert auch“ as well as in the new section; „Q3 drop it“ flips it.

dashed = new or changed · amber edge = a synthetic row written into the shipped markup of a real one (the seed has no such row) · 1 ties a change to its section's text. Synthetic data only.

①a — R6's reads and the cash check on the data-quality line Übersicht → Datenqualität · Transaktionen → Historie

Today. The line names five catalog findings, each linking to the securities list pre-filtered (/securities?dq=…). The ledger's three checks are read by the agent only. After (A). Each check with a count above zero adds one finding, in the line's shape: the count with its noun as the link, then what it does to the figures (#1121's data-effect-of). The link opens the history filtered ?dq=cash_mismatch, ?dq=rate_only or ?dq=incomplete_split, URL-driven like ?since=. The seed has none of these rows: the counts here are 1 each and the rows are synthetic.

1The filtered history's note is a problem data note, clamped, with „Alle Buchungen zeigen“ in its actions (UX-DR17: the remedy is a child of the note). It states the report's note and remedy in the operator's words: the API's remedy names PATCH /api/v1/transactions/:id and POST /api/v1/splits, the screen names „Bearbeiten“ and „Split erfassen“. The incomplete split's note names the missing portfolio and its quantity, which the history row cannot show, and links „Split erfassen“ on the security.

A row's second line (.cell-note, Sprint 22's anatomy lifted to #transaction-list) gives the figure the check compares: „aus den Zahlen: 816,00“ for the cash check (stored 806,00; the ADR's example, 10 × 81,00 + 5,00 + 1,00), „zum eigenen Kurs …“ for a rate-only trade. The other columns are the history's own.

Q1, recommended A. (1) One finding surface. The Overview's data-quality line is where the operator already reads what is wrong (UX-DR2: one line, a count only when non-zero, no all-clear); a second surface splits it, and an operator who never opens Imports never sees B. (2) The existing pattern. A count linking to the list pre-filtered to exactly its rows is how every finding on the line works (#561, #651); the history is that list for bookings, and a row there already has „Bearbeiten“, the remedy. (3) No new page, no second table. B re-draws booking rows outside the history, with their own edit buttons and their own drift from the history's columns. (4) The agent's reads stay one-to-one: each finding is one API read, each filter its rows.

B fits only if these checks were tied to imports. They are not: a hand edit (#1371) or an agent's PATCH makes a cash mismatch as well.

①b — A4's flow changes in the merge previews Konten & Depots → Depot 1 → Zusammenführen in… · Wertpapiere → Thornbury Water Fund → Zusammenführen in…

Today. The API serves flow_changes with flow_basis; the screens show only the absorbed flows, as a phrase in the „als Duplikate entfernen“ option's „Ändert auch“, and never a removed delivery or a flow across a view's boundary. After. A section „Externe Zu- und Abflüsse — bei „als Duplikate entfernen““ after the choice: one row per entry (date, effect, booking and where, quantity, the flow's change with what it is valued at). Under 720 px it becomes the preview's two-line rows. The flow_basis method sentences go into the section's ⓘ (I1, Sprint 22 board 01 ①); the short basis stays visible (②). The seed's depot pairs have no equal bookings, so both depot frames carry two synthetic pairs (amber) and the flows they would remove.

  • A removed delivery (14.03.2025, 5 Helios into Depot 1) is an external flow of the portfolio; today nothing on the screen says the return's flows change.
  • A buy straddling a view („Nur Neuzugang“) is a flow across that view's boundary; not shown today.
  • Only the absorbed cash leg is named, inside the option.
  • 1Columns: Datum · Wirkung · Buchung · wo (depot, view or account) · Stück · Fluss, with what the amount is valued at as its second line („zum gebuchten Preis“, „zum gebuchten Wert“; „zum Tageskurs“ where the delivery has no price and the change is null).
  • Wirkung names the three kinds: removed „entfällt“, boundary_removed „entfällt an der Ansichtsgrenze“, absorbed „vom gesetzten Saldo aufgenommen“.
  • The ⓘ holds the method (what each kind is, why no recomputed return, view membership unchanged); it is drawn open on the 390-px board.
  • Q3: „Ändert auch“ keeps its absorbed phrase: it is what the operator reads while choosing.

Thornbury Water Fund into its twin (seed 17c): no equal bookings, so no flow can change. Today the preview says nothing about flows.
